# Third-party files for the StarPilot web HUD bridge

Kept here so lint, spellcheck and the file-size check skip them; served by
`starpilot/system/webhud/server.py` under `/dbc/`.

| Path | What | Source |
|------|------|--------|
| `dbc/fisker_ocean_adas_world.dbc` | ADASBUS messages the HUD visualizes, cut from the FM29 ADASBUS matrix (V390.8); the bridge streams only these (and the radar's, `opendbc/dbc/fisker_ocean_mrr.dbc`) | generated by `tools/gen_world_dbc.py` in [Oceanfront View](https://github.com/moistpope/oceanfront-view), which keeps the same file for the page's decoder; copy a regenerated one here |

The DBC keeps the matrix's comments verbatim, typos included. three.js, the Ocean model and the IBUS DBC
moved to Oceanfront View with the page.
